Legal action against Eli Lilly adds volatility. result.currentSituation: Novo Nordisk is approaching its Q2 2026 earnings release scheduled for August 5, 2026, which will be a key near‑term event. However, its full‑year 2026 guidance remains weak, with adjusted sales and operating profit expected to decline 5–13% at constant exchange rates.
